name: infer-conventions
title_zh: 翻遍代码库，把你们实际写法写成 .ai/rules
tagline_zh: 团队里 Form Request 和 inline validation 混着用。
tagline_en: Your team mixes Form Requests and inline validation, and nobody can say which is the standard. It scans real.
desc_en: Use this skill to analyze how a Laravel application is actually written and record its conventions as shared rules. Trigger when the user wants to detect, infer, document, or standardize project conventions or coding style, set up or grow `.ai/rules`, resolve mixed or conflicting patterns (e.g. \"are we using Form Requests or inline validation?\"), or onboard agents and teammates to \"how we do th
why_zh: 它统计的是代码里实际出现的写法，不是你嘴上说的规范。少数派模式会被标成冲突，而不是悄悄抹平。
why_en: It counts what the code actually does, not what you claim the standard is. Minority patterns get flagged as conflicts instead of.
limit_zh: 只认 Laravel 项目，且要能读到足够多的真实代码；代码量太少或风格本就统一时，它没什么可推断的。
limit_en: Laravel only, and it needs enough real code to read; tiny or already-consistent codebases give it little to infer. Output stops at .ai/rules text.
title_en: Reads your Laravel codebase and writes its real.
